brief.terms: Same edition. Freight and taxes excluded.

offers.en: Please provide the source of the stock and evidence of authorized supply for all 100 pieces.
offers.zh: 请提供这 100 件商品的货源信息和授权供货凭证。
offers.source: 没问题，都能安排。100 只绿葡萄同版，单价 38 美元。授权供货凭证稍后提供。
offers.translation: We can arrange 100 of the same Green Grape edition at $38 each. Supply authorisation paperwork will follow.

logistics.source: 这份报价不含运费，付款后十天内发货。
logistics.translation: This quote excludes freight. We dispatch within ten days of payment.

offers.en: Please confirm the exact edition and show the batch label for all 100 pieces. Please provide supply authorisation separately from the invoice.
offers.zh: 请确认这 100 只的具体版次，提供批次标签，并在发票之外另附供货授权凭证。
offers.source: 绿葡萄可报 100 只，单价 35 美元。具体版次待确认。
offers.translation: We can quote 100 Green Grapes at $35 each. The exact edition still needs confirmation.

logistics.source: 这个价格含运费，付款后七天内发货。具体版次还在核对。
logistics.translation: The price includes freight. We dispatch within seven days of payment. We are still checking the edition.

offers.en: Please confirm stock for all 100 pieces, the dispatch date, and whether you can meet USD 40 per unit.
offers.zh: 请确认 100 件的库存、发货时间，以及单价能否控制在 40 美元以内。
offers.source: 同版绿葡萄单价 42 美元。100 只能否全发，要等仓库确认库存。
offers.translation: The same edition is $42 each. The warehouse still needs to confirm stock for all 100.

logistics.source: 库存确认后才能定交付日期，运费另外算。
logistics.translation: We can give a delivery date once stock is confirmed. Freight is extra.
